title: Cooper Light / Horizontal spacing

slide_intent: Coordinate spacing measures because uneven relationships can break a sentence into disconnected fragments.
strategic_value: Consistent spacing can make Mailchimp’s distinctive serif easier to read across messages.
demonstration: The left page repeats a headline with yellow spacing highlights; the right page explains kerning, tracking and wordspacing.
practical_value: Evaluate letter and word spacing together and distinguish the source’s rule from its inconsistent example captions.

ingredient.name: Cooper spacing
ingredient.role: Keep a headline readable as a continuous phrase.
ingredient.application: Use Optical kerning for Cooper; do not set kerning to 0. Adjust wordspacing in relation to tracking and kerning.
